'standard' uses the full rewrite; 'fast' uses a lighter one that generates several times quicker but follows long or intricate prompts less closely, and is served only by the upstream providers that honour it, so it has less failover depth.

reference_images.description: Reference image URLs (up to 9). At least one reference input is required.

resolution.description: Output video resolution. 768p is the model's native canvas; 480p is a faster, lower-cost tier; 540p is a mid tier at 1.5x the 480p price. 1080p is the highest-quality full-HD tier at 2x the 768p price (generation takes longer).

prompt.description: Describe the edit you want applied to the input video - change lighting, weather, style, environment, or specific elements.

reference_audios.description: Optional reference audio URLs to guide audio generation. Refer to them in the prompt as <Audio 1>..<Audio 3>.

reference_images.description: Optional reference image URLs to guide the edit (subject identity, style, etc.). Refer to them in the prompt as <Picture 1>..<Picture 9>.

resolution.description: Output video resolution. 768p is the model's native canvas; 480p is a faster, lower-cost tier; 540p is a mid tier at 1.5x the 480p price. 1080p is the highest-quality full-HD tier at 2x the 768p price (generation takes longer).

seed.description: The random seed to use for the generation. A negative value means a random seed will be used.

video.description: URL of the input video to edit. It drives subject identity, composition, and motion while the prompt rewrites lighting, style, environment, or specific elements.

aspect_ratio.description: The aspect ratio of the generated video.

duration.description: The duration of the generated video in seconds. Default: 5. Without video input, use an integer from 2 to 30. When reference videos are provided, the total input video duration plus the generated output duration must not exceed 30 seconds.

enable_prompt_expansion.description: If set to true, the prompt optimizer will be enabled.

generate_audio.description: Whether to include audio in the generated video.

prompt.description: The positive prompt for the generation. Refer to reference media as Image 1, Video 1, Audio 1, ..., numbered per type in array order.

reference_audios.description: Array of reference audio URLs (up to 5). Total input audio duration must not exceed 15 seconds.

reference_images.description: Array of reference image URLs (up to 10). At least one reference image, video, or audio is required.

reference_videos.description: Array of reference video URLs (up to 5). Each video must be MP4 or MOV, 1-15 seconds, 240-4096 pixels on each side, no more than 8:1 aspect ratio, and no more than 100 MB. Total input video duration must not exceed 15 seconds. Supports HTTP/HTTPS URLs and temporary OSS URLs.

seed.description: The random seed to use for the generation. -1 means a random seed will be used.
